title: trend.get
description: The method allows to retrieve trend data according to the given parameters.

itemids.description: Return only trends with the given item IDs.

time_from.description: Return only values that have been collected after or at the given time.

time_till.description: Return only values that have been collected before or at the given time.

countOutput.description: Return the number of records in the result instead of the actual data.

limit.description: Limit the number of records returned.

output.description: Object properties to be returned. Default: extend.
